relations.subject: Kirby Flower Smith
relations.evidence: He graduated from the University of Vermont in 1884.

relations.subject: Kirby Flower Smith
relations.evidence: In 1885, he attended the Johns Hopkins University and studied Greek, Latin, and Sanskrit under Professors Gildersleeve, Warren, and Bloomfield. He received the degree of Doctor of Philosophy in 1889.

relations.subject: Kirby Flower Smith
relations.evidence: He was immediately made a professor at Johns Hopkins University, and in spite of various offers from other institutions, he remained there until the day of his death.
